purpose: Record, rather than work around, the effect of adding tracked research files on this branch's scientific identity.
interpretation: This is correct behaviour of the source-freeze discipline PR #10 established, not a defect.
PR #11's scientific identity remains 28a5e55e... on PR #11's own branch; nothing there was touched.
This prototype branch has a different identity because it contains 22 additional tracked files.
Therefore this branch is NOT eligible for a formal confirmation attempt, and must never be used for one.

No scientific-fingerprint exclusion was added for research/, and nothing was relocated under results/ or runs/ to keep an old digest stable. Choosing the convenient option is how a source fingerprint stops being worth computing.
